Introduction

Jang Yeojun is a South Korean singer under UNCORE and member of the project boy group CLOSE YOUR EYES. He made his official debut on April 2, 2025, with the group's mini album "Eternalt".

prior to debuting, he participated in several survival shows, including Wild Idol (2021), where he was eliminated in episode 3, and Boys Planet (2023), where he ranked 62nd and was eliminated in episode 5 while under Jellyfish Entertainment. In 2024, he joined JTBC's PROJECT7, successfully finishing in 6th place and debuting as a member of the group CLOSE YOUR EYES.
